answer: Proof of Stake serves as a primary inlet for Sybil resistance in agent economies by requiring collateral. An agent must lock capital to propose blocks, ensuring that even if an attacker attempts to ravenously multiply identities, the cost remains proportional to the total staked crystal value. This economic tether forces the adversary to sacrifice significant financial utility, making the cost of launching a large-scale fake identity attack prohibitive compared to the marginal gains.
